## Summary

I resolved ticket T-4002 by investigating the failed pdf-exporter 1.5.0 deployment. The deploy job in the ci namespace was timing out because pod creation was being rejected in the documents namespace due to PodSecurity policy violations. The namespace enforces the "restricted:latest" policy which requires specific security context settings (allowPrivilegeEscalation=false, runAsNonRoot=true, capabilities.drop=[ALL], and seccompProfile.type=RuntimeDefault). I provided the ticket owner with the exact security context configuration needed to add to their deployment manifest to comply with these requirements.
